text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to monitor achievements along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone understands what needs to be completed. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment by discussing expectations early and keeping communication open throughout the project. When goals, milestones, and deliverables are agreed upon by all parties, the project is more likely to run smoothly and meet its objectives on time.
